description: This file is the main HTML page for a web-based database visualizer. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript to display a list of databases, tables within selected databases, and data from tables, including functionalities such as refreshing, expanding cell content, and dynamic loading.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Handles the refresh button click, reloads database list, and resets selected states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show or hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from data records and inserts into container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Returns HTML for individual table cell, handling long texts and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
